title: Cyber Security Final Examination — Multiple Choice Questions
instructions: Choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.

questions.question: What does the acronym 'CIA' stand for in the context of information security?
Which type of attack involves overwhelming a server with traffic to make it unavailable to legitimate users?
What is the primary purpose of a firewall?

options.A: To encrypt data stored on a hard drive
options.B: To monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules

questions.question: Which of the following best describes 'phishing'?

options.A: A technique to physically break into a data center
options.B: A method of encrypting sensitive files
options.C: A deceptive attempt to trick users into revealing sensitive information

questions.question: What is the main difference between symmetric and asymmetric encryption?

options.A: Symmetric encryption uses the same key for encryption and decryption; asymmetric uses a key pair
options.B: Symmetric encryption is only used for passwords
options.C: Asymmetric encryption does not require a key
options.D: There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable

questions.question: What type of malware disguises itself as legitimate software to trick users into installing it?
Which security practice involves testing a system by simulating an attack to find vulnerabilities?
What is 'two-factor authentication (2FA)' designed to do?

options.B: Add an extra layer of security by requiring two different forms of verification
options.C: Allow multiple users to share one password

options.B: A flaw that is publicly known and already patched
options.C: A previously unknown software flaw that attackers exploit before a fix is available
options.D: A type of antivirus signature update
